definitions.explanation: The act of moving a vehicle from one traffic lane to another. A common driving term.

examples.english: When changing lanes on the highway, always check behind you first.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (traffic lane) + ⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (change). A compound noun commonly used as a suru verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車線|しゃせん}{変更|へんこう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no lane changing (seen on road signs)
- ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧な{車線|しゃせん}{変更|へんこう}: reckless lane change
- {車線|しゃせん}{変更|へんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧: lane-change signal

DRIVING CONTEXT:
In Japan, highways use ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (passing lane) and ⟦{走行|そうこう}{車線|しゃせん}→走行車線：24736_soukoushasen⟧ (driving lane). Lane changes are expected to be signaled well in advance.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧: traffic lane
- ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越し：09216_oikoshi⟧: overtaking, passing
- ⟦{合流|ごうりゅう}→合流：11902_gouryuu⟧: merging (onto a highway)
